metadata.source_depth_definition: BEDROC = depth below local ground, metres; explicitly confirmed by user on 2026-11-09
metadata.boundary_method: Evaluate the same validated continuous depth surface on the existing aquifer boundary. No nearest-contour or fixed-depth boundary assignment.
metadata.interior_method: Global interpolating RBF constrained by all original contour vertices and samples at <=500m arc length. Method selected by whole-contour-level and buffered-edge withholding tests.

dem.client_sampling: bilinear interpolation between four downloaded DEM cell centres

metadata.formula: bedrock_msl = SRTM ground orthometric elevation - BEDROC depth (m)
metadata.execution: All coordinate transforms, spatial queries, depth interpolation, DEM sampling, subtraction, validation and CSV generation ran client-side in a Pyodide web worker. Host only authenticated, downloaded GEE DEM bytes, served static files, and saved browser outputs.
known_limitations: Interior depth contours do not uniquely determine depth at the aquifer boundary. The output is a modelled extension, not measured bedrock.
Spatial withholding tests support method selection only in geometries represented by the available contours; they do not validate remote boundary values.
Depth is constrained to be nonnegative. Any zero inferred from a negative prediction indicates a model-limit condition, not confirmed bedrock outcrop.
The audit sensitivity spread is disagreement between model variants, not a confidence interval.
Some existing aquifer boundary locations are over 20km from the closest original contour. These are weakly constrained and should be checked using geological maps, geophysics or boreholes.
SRTM is a February 2000 surface/terrain model on EGM96. Surface change, vegetation/buildings and datum differences can bias bedrock_msl.
Synthetic samples and output decimal precision do not establish survey accuracy.

continuous_surface.physical_constraint: depth=max(0, model_depth), so inferred bedrock cannot exceed DEM. Zero is never imposed along the aquifer boundary.
continuous_surface.extension: TPS inside the convex hull; tangent continuation outside, with slope damped exponentially over 5 km.

assessment.selection: Lowest equally weighted mean of whole-depth-level RMSE and buffered-edge RMSE among continuous RBF models. Baselines are reported, not eligible because a continuous boundary extension is requested.
assessment.note: These are internal pseudo-extrapolation tests. No measured boundary depths exist; cross-validation errors do not establish boundary accuracy or statistical confidence intervals.
